subject: Close calendar recalibrate: BrightPath Health - stage & close-date confirmation
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 procurement timeline — SFDC details?

Hi Irene / team,

Quick follow — procurement asked for a single place where we can confirm the milestone dates and a point of contact for any last-minute contract questions. Can you confirm the expected close date and which stage we should be tracking in your system? Legal and finance need a close date to schedule internal approvals.

We are still finalizing a line-item with our integrations team; looks like that could push signing by 2–3 weeks, but I want to avoid having stale records in your forecast if that shifts us out of Q3.

Can someone from your side confirm today? Thanks.

— Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Procurement, BrightPath Health
elaine.park@brightpathhealth.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 procurement timeline — SFDC details?

Thanks Elaine — copying the GTM owners.

Vanessa / Ben, quick request to get our forecast accurate before tomorrow's finance sync: please do the following by EOD Wed (8/19):

1) Update the SFDC Opportunity (BPH-7843) Stage to the most realistic value right now (Proposal / Contract / Commit). If the current team estimate is >50% to close in Q3, mark as Commit and leave Close Date as 2026-09-30.
2) If the team believes the earliest realistic close slips beyond 2026-09-30, set Close Date to the best estimate and add an internal note explaining the blocker ("integration dependency - ETA Oct 15").
3) If there's no clear owner or buyer commitment, change Stage to "Qualification - Stalled" and move Close Date out 30 days (we'll re-evaluate).

I attached a short Deal_Triage_Checklist.xlsx — use it to capture the approval owners, gating items, and the next actionable step. Also drop a line in the HubSpot record (link below) with a one-sentence status so finance can trace changes.

Elaine — we'll confirm with procurement the same day and flag any change to the forecast. If legal needs a DocuSign timeline, call that out in the notes and we'll escalate.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Deal_Triage_Checklist.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 13:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 procurement timeline — SFDC details?

Thanks Irene — I spoke with Elaine for 10 mins after this thread. Short update for the record:

- BrightPath integration team says a final test run is scheduled for week of Sep 20; realistic earliest sign is 9/29–10/05.
- Customer is optimistic about Q3 but not confident at >60% probability.
- Action: I'll ask procurement to push for a 9/30 sign if tests pass; otherwise they'll accept early Oct.

I'll update the HubSpot notes and ping Ben to move the SFDC fields. If legal needs a hard deadline for DocuSign requests, I'll get one today.

Vanessa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine.park@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q3 procurement timeline — SFDC details?

Acknowledged — I made the changes in SFDC as discussed:

- Stage: Proposal (internal) -> set to "Qualification - Stalled" — reason: integration acceptance pending.
- Close Date: moved from 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-15 (best-estimate).
- Probability: set to 25%.
- Internal note added: "Integration test scheduled week of 9/20; procurement prefers 9/30 but likely early Oct. Owner: Elaine Park (procurement@brightpathhealth.com). See HubSpot link for procurement thread"

HubSpot note: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/brightpath-health — updated with my timestamp.

If anyone disagrees with the 10/15 date, speak now; otherwise finance will treat this as an out-of-Q3 movement in tomorrow's forecast.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Forecast & RevOps, Redwood Inference
